entities.name: On the Origin of Species
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Charles Darwin's 1859 groundbreaking work proposing that species evolve through natural selection. It revolutionized biology, challenged theological accounts of creation, and remains one of the most influential scientific works ever published.
